desc: Parse N, M, Sx, Sy, house coordinates, and moves.
Simulate moves with Python ints to compute final (X,Y) and collect horizontal segments (y, x1, x2) and vertical segments (x, y1, y2).
Merge horizontal intervals per y and vertical intervals per x (sort by start, merge if next_start <= current_end + 1).
For each house, binary search merged intervals for its row and column to test coverage; compute H, V, B.
Output X Y and H + V - B.
